title: Square-Difference Factor Absorbing Primary Hyperideals of Multiplicative Hyperrings
content: We introduce and study square-difference factor absorbing primary hyperideals (sdf-absorbing primary hyperideals) in commutative multiplicative hyperrings. A proper hyperideal I is called sdf-absorbing primary if x2-y2 \( \subseteq \) I implies \( x+y\in\sqrt{I} \) or \( x-y\in I \). This class provides a proper common generalization of both primary hyperideals and sdf-absorbing hyperideals. We establish a comprehensive characterization, investigate the behavior under homomorphisms, localization, intersections, ascending chains, and Cartesian  products, and identify the precise conditions under which the three notions coincide.
